migrations.description: Replaces @nx/powerpack-conformance with @nx/conformance, which nx conformance now loads. Rewrites its rule specifiers, executors and imports, points ensure-owners at @nx/owners, and adds esbuild for the bundle-rules executor.
migrations.name: 24-1-0-replace-powerpack-conformance

migrations.description: Adds the `@nx/directive-checks` rule to the root ESLint config that project configs extend, in workspaces whose files use the `@nx-depends-on` or `@nx-ignore-server-inputs` directives.
migrations.name: update-24-1-0-add-directive-checks-rule

migrations.description: Prepare the workspace for ESLint v10: convert eslintrc configs to flat config, since v10 removed the eslintrc format, and replace the ESLint plugins that have no v10 release.
migrations.name: update-24-1-0-migrate-to-eslint-v10

migrations.description: Replaces the removed `classProperties.loose` option with `loose` for the `@nx/js/babel`, `@nx/react/babel` and `@nx/web/babel` presets in JSON babel config files.
migrations.name: update-24-1-0-replace-babel-class-properties-loose

migrations.description: Enables JWT API tokens in Verdaccio config files used by `@nx/js:verdaccio` targets, so Verdaccio 7+ accepts the placeholder npm auth token that Nx sets for the local registry.
migrations.name: update-24-1-0-add-verdaccio-jwt-security

migrations.description: Add the patches and local_path_modules paths to the outputs of @nx/js:prune-lockfile targets that declare a bun.lock or bun.lockb output (adding bun.lock next to a bun.lockb one), and the workspace root package.json to their inputs, so a cache replay restores the bun patch files and vendored local-path dependencies the executor now emits, and a change to the root trustedDependencies does not replay a stale output.
migrations.name: update-24-1-0-add-bun-prune-lockfile-cache-config

migrations.description: Add the trustedDependencies and patchedDependencies fields of the root package.json to the inputs of build targets that emit the pruned Bun deploy output (esbuild with generatePackageJson, tsc and swc with generateLockfile, and project or targetDefaults entries replacing the inputs of inferred webpack and rspack builds) in workspaces on bun.lock or the binary bun.lockb, so removing a package from trustedDependencies does not replay a cached output that still trusts it.
migrations.name: update-24-1-0-add-bun-deploy-output-cache-inputs

migrations.description: Removes the `@angular-devkit/build-angular:ssr-dev-server` targets of Rspack projects whose `serverTarget` values all name missing targets. Those targets can't run.
migrations.name: update-24-1-0-remove-rspack-ssr-dev-server-targets
